# TelegramStars — suffix 'звёзд', greedy user field
50 звёзд, по логину, @nick
100 stars, @user, extra info
200 звёзд, по номеру, @user123
500 stars, login, @shop, gift for friend
1000 звёзд, telegram login, @biguser

# Topup — optional promo present and absent
Steam, 500 руб.
Origin, 1000 руб.
Xbox, 750 руб., SALE2026
PlayStation, 2000 руб., PROMO
Nintendo, 500 руб.

# TopupReverse — amount first
1000 руб., NEWYEAR

300 руб., Google Play

# Boost — greedy description swallows multiple segments
boost, 70 lvl, mythic+, USD, $250, 3 дн.
arena, 2200 rating, USD, $150, 5 дн.
mythic plus, 10/10, EUR, $800, 14 дн.
leveling 1-60, RUB, $50, 3 дн.

foo, bar, 42

one, two, three
no numbers here, just text
